basics.name: Chrystal Chern
basics.label: Postdoctoral Researcher, UC Berkeley
basics.summary: Dynamics researcher specializing in IMU-based motion sensing, system identification, and digital twins of physical systems, with experience spanning sensor instrumentation, standards-based experimental testing, and signal-level characterization through production-quality Python analysis tools.

work.name: Dynamics Lab & STAIRLab (STructural Artificial Intelligence Research Lab), UC Berkeley
work.summary: Research on sensing, system identification, and modeling of mechanical and structural systems.
highlights: Lead instrumentation, signal processing, and data analysis for kinematic motion tracking.
Apply inverse dynamic analysis to coupled human-object biomechanical systems using multi-node IMU sensor networks; led experiment design, sensor placement, and data collection.
Developed network analysis methodology and Python analysis code to identify the causal body-segment motions driving induced object motion (Nonlinear Dynamics, submitted 2026).
Evaluate system identification prediction residuals and modal clustering for anomaly detection and early-warning structural health monitoring under environmental and seismic loads.
Supervise graduate and undergraduate researchers in data-driven system dynamics.

work.name: Berkeley Discovery Initiative, UC Berkeley
work.position: Program Strategist, Research Mentorship and Student Impact
work.summary: Design and assess tiered mentorship and immersive research programs that give students ownership over creation and innovation.
highlights: Co-developed an interdisciplinary research mentorship program spanning 8 research hubs, 30+ graduate fellows, and 170 undergraduates.
Led survey and focus-group assessment and co-secured $170k in continuing funding.

work.name: STAIRLab & Pacific Earthquake Engineering Research Center (PEER), UC Berkeley
work.summary: Bridge Rapid Assessment Center for Extreme Events (BRACE2), Structural ImageNet, and feature engineering for structural health monitoring.
highlights: Developed California's production web platform for automated bridge health monitoring (Caltrans).
Performed system identification and finite element modeling of bridges and buildings.
Developed machine learning anomaly detection for bridge damage diagnosis within a human-machine collaboration framework (Journal of Bridge Engineering, 2024).
Developed deep learning image classification models for structural health monitoring.
Built feature engineering pipelines for damage classification from augmented structural response time-history data.

work.name: Simpson Gumpertz & Heger Inc.
work.summary: Building enclosure engineering, simulation, and field testing in Washington, DC.
highlights: Performed parametric energy, daylighting, and thermal finite element analysis (2D/3D) of curtain wall, cladding, and custom skylight assemblies.
Conducted infrared thermography surveys and analysis for non-destructive diagnostics.

Performed on-site water penetration and air infiltration testing of installed cladding assemblies per ASTM/AAMA standards, including instrumented pressure-chamber test setup, acceptance-criteria evaluation, and leak-path diagnosis.
Analyzed wind loads on components and cladding per structural code.

work.name: MIT Digital Structures Lab
work.summary: Experimental characterization of fine-resolution anisotropic material properties of 3D printed materials via ASTM tensile testing.

work.name: Dassault Systemes SOLIDWORKS Corp.
work.summary: CAD and FEA software testing in Woodland Hills, CA.
highlights: Investigated user-reported software issues across Computer Aided Design (CAD) and Finite Element Analysis (FEA) products for the SOLIDWORKS 2015 Beta program.
Contributed to the redesign of the engineering technical support knowledge base.

volunteer.organization: Resilient Cities and Structures; Computers and Structures; Computer-Aided Civil and Infrastructure Engineering
volunteer.summary: Peer reviewer for journals in structural engineering and computing.

volunteer.organization: UC Berkeley SEMM & CEE Scholars Programs
volunteer.summary: Designed and supervised structural health monitoring and sensor projects for 5 undergraduate researchers.

volunteer.organization: UC Berkeley SEMM-DSR (Doctoral Students and Researchers Organization)
volunteer.summary: Founded and led the doctoral students and researchers organization for Structural Engineering, Mechanics, and Materials.
Managed an international development engineering project and chapter fundraising.
